title: Porch insight: the Big Bang as a ripple inside a universe at rest, as an explanation for where the Virgin Mary came from

tellings.quote: Was was sitting in my porch with screens all around my porch and picturing the Big Bang for the first time in my life.

plain: Sitting on his screened porch, a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he pictured the Big Bang for the first time and saw it as a ripple inside a universe that was otherwise at rest. He tells this as his own insight, drawing on thinkers such as Thomas Aquinas, Gottfried Leibniz and Albert Einstein, and offers it as a way to explain where the Virgin Mary came from.
